Leave empty if not stated; never infer from the receipt.", "name": "cost_code", "optional": true, "type": "string"}, {"control_type": "text", "description": "The business purpose of the purchase (what it was for, e.g. 'DocuSign annual plan', 'site visit'), stated in the EMAIL BODY.
